sentences.en: Trying to fit us all in that break room.

sentences.en: I don't think they thought that through.
Well, I think that's why maybe the following year, they put us all in the warehouse.
In front of a bunch of paper boxes.

sentences.en: They would put us in different pairings.
sentences.zh: 他们会把我们分成不同的组合。

sentences.en: And that would be our morning.
sentences.zh: 我们的整个上午就这样度过了。

sentences.en: We would spend four or five hours just cycling through doing promotional photos.
sentences.zh: 我们会花四到五个小时不停地拍宣传照。

sentences.en: But we also had to be doing the show.
So if you weren't getting your picture taken, then you were shooting a scene.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你没在拍照，那你就在拍戏。

sentences.en: And then also, you would have sort of like a full-on press junket day.
sentences.zh: 然后还有那种全方位的媒体连线日。

sentences.en: And you would get paired up with someone.
sentences.zh: 你会和某个人被分到一组。

sentences.zh: 我们必须大清早就到片场。

sentences.en: You know, we would arrive at 3 a.m.

sentences.en: You do that for three minutes.

sentences.zh: 我们要依次连线这些城市的早间新闻节目。

sentences.zh: 他们会说，好了，伙计们，下一个是俄亥俄州托莱多市。

sentences.zh: 到最后，你根本不知道自己在和谁说话了。

sentences.zh: 他们会安排一些短暂的休息时间。

sentences.zh: 通常还会有一个稍微长一点的休息时间，你可以去吃点早餐，直到

sentences.zh: 做完这些之后，你才开始正常的工作日。

sentences.zh: 所以我们连线三小时后，才开始正常的工作日。

sentences.en: And, you know, everyone was always so gracious.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，每个人都总是那么亲切。

sentences.zh: 但我现在对所有那些通过卫星连线到脱口秀节目的人有了全新的理解

sentences.en: to a talk show because there is that delay.

sentences.zh: 而且我确信所有在听的各位以前都见过这种情况。

sentences.en: Someone's on your news program and they pop in and the person asks the question like,
sentences.zh: 有人上了你们的新闻节目，他们连线进来，然后主持人问出这样的问题：

sentences.en: all right, can you tell us about this new season of your TV show?
sentences.zh: “好吧，你能跟我们聊聊你们电视剧的新一季吗？”

sentences.en: And then they're like, yes, I can't.
sentences.zh: 然后他们的反应却是：好的，我不能。
而且他们一直没解决这个问题。

sentences.en: There's a delay and it's always a little tricky.
sentences.zh: 有延迟，而且总是有点棘手。

sentences.en: But anyway, it is a lot of moving parts the way shows and movies come together and the promotion.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，电视剧和电影的筹备以及宣传过程涉及很多繁杂的环节。

sentences.en: I have a lot of respect for all the different departments.
sentences.zh: 我对所有不同的部门都充满敬意。

sentences.en: But it has to get folded into your already very busy work week.
sentences.zh: 但这一切必须融入你本来就已经很忙碌的工作周中。

sentences.en: And all of that scheduling would have to go through the producers.
sentences.zh: 所有这些日程安排都必须通过制片人来协调。

sentences.en: If someone needed to go do a taping of The Tonight Show,
sentences.zh: 如果有人需要去录制《今夜秀》，

sentences.zh: 我们就得把整个拍摄日程重新调整，因为我们其他人还要继续拍戏。

sentences.en: You know, it's like late afternoon.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像是下午晚些时候。

sentences.en: So a workday is still happening half the time.
sentences.zh: 所以有半天时间工作日仍在继续。

梳着那种严厉紧绷的发髻。

sentences.en: Maybe I should have one time.
sentences.zh: 也许我真该有一次那样去。

sentences.zh: 嗯，有一件事，我现在脑子里有点想不起来具体是什么了，

sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们当时有什么活动必须得去。

sentences.zh: 我想不起来那是哪一次了。
